'''Jonathan Dansbury''' (also published as '''Jon Dansbury''') is a New Jersey Star Wars CCG player who finished 13th at [[June 2001 Marlton tournament]] on 3 June 2001, according to Greg Shaw's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2409">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-04-marlton-nj-06-03-01d2409/ marlton-nj-06-03-01], DeckTech (Greg "TychoCelchu" Shaw, 4 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-04-marlton-nj-06-03-01d2409/ GitHub Pages].</ref> He played at the [[2001 New Jersey State Championship]] and at [[May 2002 Livingston tournament]] on 25 May 2002 with DS Combat with Podrace, according to Ted Panczyszyn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3691">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-05-26-regional-warmup-livingston-nj-5-25-02d3691/ regional-warmup-livingston-nj-5-25-02], DeckTech (Ted "Rogue15" Panczyszyn, 26 May 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-05-26-regional-warmup-livingston-nj-5-25-02d3691/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
